% glossaries with \noist and a makeindex style file next to the
% document, test-glossaries-ist.ist, whose preamble prints a line above
% the glossary
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{glossaries}
\noist
\setStyleFile{test-glossaries-ist}
\makeglossaries
\newglossaryentry{group}{name={group},
  description={a set with an associative operation}}
\begin{document}
A \gls{group}.
\printglossaries
\end{document}
